scope: Post-hoc internal model-development analysis of all 64 completed October 11/12 seed rows; no simulation, physical cause, mass, grid/domain or validation claim.

definitions.time: Piecewise-constant at-or-before states and exact next recorded event. Sensitivity uses each adjacent alternative, exact time uses exact state only; no interpolation or confidence interval.
definitions.geometry: Seed plus exact event coordinates; new axial and maximum Cartesian lateral center spans. Occupancy means attached lattice sites, not mass. Seed volume, shape, surface and diffusion environment differ.
definitions.comparisons: Within-condition ages share all eight rows. Forcing matched ages share all 24 at one temperature. Temperature matched ages share all 32 at fraction .15. Do not mix independently chosen times.
definitions.sizeStages: First maximum-lattice-extent crossing, not common time or identical geometry.

eightRowBaselineCost.limits: Observed CFL .05 rows under original contention. New CFL .025 seed cost is unmeasured; no estimate or transfer claim.

assurance.author: Codex/GPT-6 analysis subagent, inherited context
assurance.method: Exact readRow and window/increments/contrast function bodies copied from the previously checked saved-data history.mjs; existing bracketCavityTime and summarizeFirstBatchRow called unchanged. New scratch code selects complete seed blocks and common-age sets, counts scoped contrasts and packages outputs.
assurance.executed: All 64 row specs matched current retained roster entries; all cflFill=.05, dx=.35; strict at-every-event coordinate/count/extent/AR reconstruction and all endpoint checks passed. No new numerical calculation module, solver, gate, tests or simulation.
assurance.limits: No independent review of this complete report, no full fields, timestep/grid/domain qualification, external physical source or held-out comparison. Bounded source diff between fixed producers is empty for core, solver-cpu, worker and bracket helper.
